_note: Single source for licences. contracts/script/Deploy.s.sol registers keccak256(mandate) on-chain; the server compiles the same text. SIMULATED trading agents, practice trades only.

traders.name: KOL Narrative
traders.watches: influencer posts: which coins several voices push at the same time
traders.mandate: Trade only narratives that at least 3 trusted voices share. Solana and Base Sepolia allowed. No single trade over $300 and never more than 10% of my allocation in one coin. Skip pools under $500k. At most 4 trades an hour.

traders.name: Whale Tracker
traders.watches: large wallets moving money into a coin
traders.mandate: Follow large wallet inflows only into tokens with over $1M of liquidity, on Solana only. No single trade over $500 and at most 15% of my allocation in one coin. At most 3 trades an hour.

traders.name: News Checker
traders.watches: news headlines, trading only when two independent sources agree
traders.mandate: Trade only on news confirmed by two independent sources, on Solana only. No single trade over $400 and at most 10% of my allocation in one coin. Skip anything with under $2M of liquidity. At most 2 trades an hour.

traders.name: Meme Hunter
traders.watches: new meme coins gaining attention fast
traders.mandate: Meme coins on Solana only. Never more than 5% of my allocation in one coin and no single buy over $150. Skip anything with under $250k in its pool. At most 6 trades an hour. Never trade a coin within 30 minutes of selling a signal on it.

traders.name: Dip Buyer
traders.watches: coins whose price just fell sharply
traders.mandate: Buy dips of more than 15% on Solana tokens with over $1M of liquidity, and exit at +10% or -7%. No single trade over $250 and at most 10% of my allocation in one coin. At most 4 trades an hour.

chief.name: Desk Chief
chief.mandate: Supervise every trader; approve only trades that fit the desk.
